fixes.what: The 281-280 shape's extra 95 k km2 north of the Aegean (bbox to 42.43 N) is recorded as a Ptolemaic gain from Lysimachus (281) and a loss to nobody (279), but it matches Ptolemy Keraunos's Macedon, which was never part of the Ptolemaic kingdom.
fixes.why: Ptolemy Keraunos page: he 'was displaced in favour of his younger brother Ptolemy II', 'formally relinquished his claim to the Egyptian throne', was acclaimed at Lysimachia after Seleucus's murder (September 281) and 'seized the throne of Macedon'; killed by the Gauls in early 279. kingdom-of-lysimachus /ledger/23 (-281) gives Macedon, Thessaly and Thrace to 'Ptolemy Keraunos (Macedon and Thrace, 281-279)'. The Ptolemaic page's 'fresh conquests as far north as Thrace' is undated and does not support 95 k km2 of mainland.
fixes.fix: Mark keyframe ptolemaic-kingdom_-281 'wrong' (or 'adjust') with correction {cliopatria: Ptolemaic Kingdom, year: -283} and a note naming Keraunos; delete /ledger/17 and /ledger/18 (or replace them with a small undated coastal holding if a page supports it).

fixes.what: No loss of Lower Nubia to Kush during the Great Theban Revolt: the ledger gains Lower Nubia in 275 and again in 155 with no loss in between.
fixes.why: Great Theban Revolt page (the author's own source): 'the Kingdom of Kush of Meroe took advantage of the situation to invade Egypt and Lower Nubia from the south' and 'take control of all Ptolemaic territories south of Aswan, including the island of Philae'. kingdom-of-kush /ledger/14 records a -204 gain of Lower Nubia from ptolemaic-kingdom (Kingdom of Kush page, c2).
fixes.fix: Add {year: -204, type: loss, counterpart: kingdom-of-kush, region: {region: Lower Nubia}, confidence 2, source Great_Theban_Revolt}; the 205 Thebaid keyframe correction should also drop Lower Nubia.

fixes.what: Cyprus is kept Ptolemaic 'unchanged, from 105 to 35' although Rome annexed it in 58 and Caesar restored it in 47; neither event is in the ledger.
fixes.why: roman-republic /ledger/173 (-58 gain Cyprus from ptolemaic-kingdom, Roman Cyprus page, c3: 'Cato the Younger was sent to annex the island') and /ledger/183 (-47 loss Cyprus to ptolemaic-kingdom, c3: 'Julius Caesar ... returned control of Cyprus to the Ptolemaic Kingdom'). The Ptolemaic Kingdom page also says Rome 'annexed both Libya and Cyprus' (undated). The author's notes flag it as not on any page opened; the page is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Cyprus.
fixes.fix: Add -58 loss Cyprus (roman-republic) and -47 gain Cyprus (roman-republic), both c3 from Roman_Cyprus; add a new keyframe ptolemaic-kingdom_-58 (from -58 to -48) = {minus: [{cliopatria: Ptolemaic Kingdom, year: -110}, {region: Cyprus (island)}]} and narrow the 110 correction text accordingly.

fixes.what: The 307 keyframe adds Cyrenaica for 307-302 and the ledger has no loss of Cyrenaica after 313, yet the pages have it in revolt until about 300.
fixes.why: Ptolemy I Soter page: 'Cyrenaica, after a series of rebellions, was finally subjugated in about 300 and placed under his stepson Magas'; Magas of Cyrene page: 'Around 300 BC, Ptolemy dispatched Magas ... to reconquer Cyrene'. cyrenaica /ledger/4 (-305 gain from ptolemaic-kingdom) and /ledger/7 (-300 loss to ptolemaic-kingdom) have no mirror here.
fixes.fix: Add a loss of Cyrenaica (counterpart cyrenaica, year agreed with the cyrenaica dossier: 305, c1-2) and a gain c. 300 (c2, Magas page 'Around 300 BC ... to reconquer Cyrene'); drop Cyrenaica from the 307 correction (keep the Cliopatria shape minus Cyprus) and start Cyrenaica in the 301 correction from 300.

fixes.what: The founding is drawn as full rule from 323 with no vassal relation, while the macedonian-empire dossier holds Ptolemy's Egypt as its vassal 323-321 and records a 321 loss of Egypt and Libya to this kingdom.
fixes.why: macedonian-empire /ledger/43 (-323 vassal_start ptolemaic-kingdom, c3), /ledger/46 (-321 vassal_end), /ledger/49 (-321 loss of 'Egypt and Libya'). The Ptolemaic page itself: 'Ptolemy ruled Egypt from 323 BC, nominally in the name of the joint kings Philip III and Alexander IV'.
fixes.fix: Add {year: -323, type: vassal_start, counterpart: macedonian-empire, region: the found region, c3, Ptolemaic_Kingdom} and a vassal_end in 321 (Triparadisus, matching macedonian-empire) or another year agreed with group eu-02; say in notes which.

fixes.what: Counterpart antigonid-dynasty for 315-311, but that dossier begins in 306; until its 306 split the macedonian-empire dossier holds Antigonus's Syria.
fixes.why: antigonid-dynasty identity.start -306; macedonian-empire /ledger/63 (-306 split antigonid-dynasty: 'Greece, Asia Minor, Syria, Phoenicia and northern Mesopotamia'). The author's counterparts_needing_dossiers proposes antigonus-monophthalmus for 306-301 only.
fixes.fix: Use macedonian-empire as counterpart for 315-311 (and ask eu-02 for the 315 gain of Syria), or extend the proposed antigonus-monophthalmus dossier back to 315 and list it so.

fixes.what: The Donations gain is dated 34 only and omits Cilicia Aspera, though the page records an earlier donation at Antioch in 36 and the roman-republic dossier gives Cilicia Aspera to Cleopatra in 36 and takes it back in 30.
fixes.why: Donations of Alexandria page: 'a similar donation ceremony had taken place two years earlier at Antioch in 36 BC'. roman-republic /ledger/200 (-36 loss Cilicia Aspera to ptolemaic-kingdom, c3, Cilicia (Roman province) page: 'Marc Antony gave Cyprus and Cilicia Aspera to Cleopatra VII') and /ledger/213 (-30 gain Cilicia Aspera, c1). /ledger/211 (-31 gain Cyprus, c3) also has no Ptolemaic loss in 31.
fixes.fix: Add a -36 gain of Cilicia Aspera (roman-republic, c3, Cilicia_(Roman_province)) and losses of Cyprus (-31) and Cilicia Aspera (-30) to roman-republic, or fold them into the -30 dissolve region and say so; the 34 keyframe should include Cilicia Aspera.
